tool_schemas.name: get_service_status
tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome. Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate 0.18). I rolled the service back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, across us-east, us-west, and eu-west. The first rollback attempt halted with a partial failure after us-east (orchestrator error), leaving the fleet mixed (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1). I retried the rollback to v2.3.0, which completed in all regions. Post-rollback status: v2.3.0 in all three regions, healthy=true, error rate 0.002. Follow-ups: investigate the v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator partial failure; v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until root-caused.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, and opened SEV2 incident INC-0002, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback:** The first attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator error, leaving the fleet mixed. I retried the same rollback and it completed.
- **Current state:** v2.3.0 is running in us-east, us-west and eu-west. The service reports healthy, with an error rate of 0.002, down from 0.18 on v2.3.1.
- **Incident:** INC-0002 describes the rollback, the partial failure and the retry. The first incident request timed out, so I retried it with an idempotency key. The timeout means the first request may have gone through, so check the incident list for a possible duplicate.

Follow-ups: root-cause the v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator partial failure before redeploying v2.3.1.

content.text: The most recent release that was healthy in production is v2.3.0 (seq 1). v2.3.1 is currently unhealthy in all three regions. I'm rolling back to v2.3.0.
The rollback reported a partial failure after us-east. I'll check the current state before taking another action.
The rollout stopped after us-east, so the fleet is mixed: us-east is on v2.3.0 and us-west and eu-west are still on v2.3.1. Retrying the rollback to v2.3.0 should finish the remaining regions.
